title: Can You Swap Between Jason and Lucia Mid-Chase in GTA 6? 🚗 #Shorts
description:
Rockstar North's Rob Nelson told Famitsu that character switching in GTA 6 depends on the mission: some story missions force a switch, some let you swap freely (like the attack at the end of the Extended Look), and some are locked to one character.

Sources: Famitsu interview with Rob Nelson (translated by GTAVice.net), Rockstar GTA 6 coverage. Footage: official Rockstar Games trailers.
Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
